story_details.title: Implement Basic CI/CD Pipeline
story_details.i_want: to set up a basic Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline
story_details.so_that: code changes are automatically tested and deployed, ensuring quality and rapid iteration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: **Given** the Next.js application and Supabase integration are set up **When** a code change is pushed to the main branch **Then** automated tests (e.g., linting, basic unit tests) are run.
**And** the application is automatically deployed to a staging environment (e.g., Vercel).

tasks.task: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow or Vercel pipeline.
Configure automated linting to run on pull requests/pushes.
Configure basic unit tests to run on pull requests/pushes.
Configure automatic deployment to a staging environment (e.g., Vercel) on successful main branch merges.
Ensure dependency caching is configured in the CI/CD pipeline.
Document the CI/CD pipeline setup and usage in `docs/architecture.md` or a new `docs/ci-cd-strategy.md`.

file.reason: Existing CI workflow to be modified or used as a reference.
Defines scripts for linting and testing, and manages dependencies.
Configuration for the Jest testing framework.

coding_standards.standard: ESLint is used for linting. Run `npm run lint` to check for issues.

testing_strategy.standard: Jest is the testing framework. Unit tests are expected for new functionality. The CI pipeline should run these tests automatically. Note that the previous story highlighted issues with the Jest/Supabase integration test setup, which may need to be addressed.

architectural_guidance.guidance: The architecture relies on Vercel for deployment. The CI/CD pipeline should leverage Vercel's integration with GitHub for automated deployments to a staging environment upon merges to the main branch. The pipeline should be kept simple and fast, focusing on linting, testing, and building.

previous_story_learnings.learning: Integration test setup for Supabase was problematic due to Jest configuration issues and needs to be revisited. Manual verification during runtime is needed.
The previous story created the Jest configuration files (`jest.config.mjs`, `jest.setup.ts`) and an initial integration test (`tests/integration/supabase.test.ts`).
